title: What happened in AI — Jul 20, 2026
intro: Moonshot's Kimi K3 launch kept reshaping markets a day later: Samsung and SK Hynix shares rebounded on bets that cheaper, more capable open models raise compute demand rather than cut into it, and Moonshot is now moving toward a Hong Kong IPO with Kimi K3's US market impact cited as the catalyst.

A newly surfaced 2022 email shows Sam Altman once proposed the same playbook Moonshot is now running: release a capable open model specifically to discourage funding for smaller open-source rivals. The document emerged from the Musk v. Altman litigation, not from OpenAI.
highlights: Samsung and SK Hynix shares rebounded on a Jevons Paradox thesis that cheaper, Kimi K3-class open models grow overall compute demand rather than shrink it.
Moonshot AI is moving ahead with a Hong Kong IPO, with Kimi K3's hit to US tech stocks cited as the catalyst.
Business Insider reports Silicon Valley is rattled by China's strategy of releasing frontier-capable models as open weights.

A 2022 Sam Altman email surfaced in the Musk v. Altman case shows OpenAI once planned to release a weaker open model to block funding for open-source competitors — the dynamic now playing out in reverse.

categories.name: Kimi K3 Rattles Chips, Accelerates Moonshot's IPO
categories.summary: Moonshot's Kimi K3 launch is reshaping downstream markets: semiconductor stocks are rebounding on rising compute-demand bets, and Moonshot is moving toward a Hong Kong listing.

articles.title: Moonshot launches China's largest AI Model Kimi K3
articles.summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3, billed as China's largest AI model, intensifying open-weight competition with US frontier labs.

articles.title: Silicon Valley is freaking out over China's open-source AI strategy
articles.summary: US labs are reportedly rattled by China's strategy of releasing frontier-capable models as open weights, with Kimi K3 as the latest example.

articles.title: Samsung, SK Hynix Rebound on Kimi K3's Jevons Paradox-Driven Demand
articles.summary: Samsung and SK Hynix shares rebounded on the thesis that cheaper, more capable open models like Kimi K3 increase overall compute demand rather than cannibalize it.

articles.title: China's Moonshot AI plans Hong Kong IPO after its latest model rattled US tech stocks
articles.summary: Moonshot is moving ahead with a Hong Kong IPO, with Kimi K3's impact on US tech stocks cited as a catalyst.

categories.name: OpenAI's 2022 Plan to Block Open-Source Rivals, Surfaced in Court
categories.summary: A Sam Altman email disclosed in the Musk v. Altman litigation shows OpenAI once planned to pre-empt open-weight competitors with its own weaker open release — the same dynamic now playing out with Kimi K3, in reverse.

articles.title: Quoting Sam Altman
articles.summary: An October 2022 email to OpenAI's board, surfaced in the Musk v. Altman case, has Altman proposing a GPT-3-class open model to run locally, explicitly to 'discourage others from releasing similarly-powerful models' and starve smaller open-source efforts of funding.
